name: Social graph
description: Map who knows whom among your people, how close they are, and the groups they form.
title: Social graph
needPeople: Add a couple of people first
needPeopleDescription: The graph connects people from your People list, so it needs at least two.
graphLabel: Graph of your people and how they're connected
hint: Tap people in the graph to select them. Pick two to say how close they are, or several to put them in a group.
noGroups: No groups yet. Select a few people to start one.
notePlaceholder: How do they know each other?
disconnectDescription: The connection and its note are removed. Their groups stay as they are.
groupFull: A group can hold up to {{count}} people.
deleteGroupDescription: The group is removed. The people in it, and their connections, stay.

graph.title: See who knows whom
graph.lede: Everyone from your People list, joined by how close they are. Thicker lines are closer ties; colored rings show the groups someone belongs to — one arc per group.

strength.title: Closeness in one tap
strength.lede: Select two people and pick a bar. Add a note if it helps you remember how they met.
strength.previewNote: Just a preview — nothing here is saved.
